extracted.intended_audience: owners/operators of CCR units (facility environmental/compliance staff), State Directors, and appropriate Tribal authorities
extracted.subtask_short: CCR operating record and website compliance
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements for what information owners/operators of coal combustion residuals (CCR) units must place in the facility operating record and on a publicly accessible CCR website, including notification rules, posting deadlines, and document retention/maintenance durations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of EAP activations (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation recording any activation of the emergency action plan (EAP) as required by §§ 257.73(a)(3)(v) and 257.74(a)(3)(v).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each documentation of EAP activations must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of the time requirement specified in paragraph (b) of this section.

rubrics_metrics.name: History of construction (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The history of construction, and any revisions of it, as required by § 257.73(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each history of construction must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of the time requirement specified in paragraph (b) of this section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial and periodic structural stability assessments (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial and periodic structural stability assessments as required by §§ 257.73(d) and 257.74(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each structural stability assessment must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of the time requirement specified in paragraph (b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of corrective measures to remedy deficiency or release (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation detailing the corrective measures taken to remedy the deficiency or release as required by §§ 257.73(d)(2) and 257.74(d)(2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each document must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial and periodic safety factor assessments (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial and periodic safety factor assessments as required by §§ 257.73(e) and 257.74(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each safety factor assessment must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design and construction plans (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The design and construction plans, and any revisions of them, as required by § 257.74(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each design and construction plan must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application and supplemental materials (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The application and any supplemental materials submitted in support of the application as required by § 257.71(d)(1)(i)(E).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each application and supplemental materials must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative liner demonstration (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The alternative liner demonstration as required by § 257.71(d)(1)(ii)(D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the demonstration in the operating record as required by the cited provision; retention/posting durations referenced elsewhere in this section may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative liner demonstration extension request (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The alternative liner demonstration extension request as required by § 257.71(d)(2)(ii)(D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the extension request in the operating record as required by the cited provision; retention/posting durations referenced elsewhere in this section may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation for the preliminary demonstration (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The documentation prepared for the preliminary demonstration as required by § 257.71(d)(2)(ii)(E).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the documentation in the operating record as required by the cited provision; retention/posting durations referenced elsewhere in this section may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of an incomplete application (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of an incomplete application as required by § 257.71(d)(2)(iii)(B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the notification in the operating record; other retention rules may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision on the application (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The decision on the application as required by § 257.71(d)(2)(iii)(F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each decision must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final decision on the alternative liner demonstration (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The final decision on the alternative liner demonstration as required by § 257.71(d)(2)(vii).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the final decision in the operating record; retention rules elsewhere may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative source demonstration (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The alternative source demonstration as required under § 257.71(d)(2)(ix)(A)(4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the demonstration in the operating record as required by the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final decision on the alternative source demonstration (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The final decision on the alternative source demonstration as required under § 257.71(d)(2)(ix)(A)(5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the final decision in the operating record as required by the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final decision on the trend analysis (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The final decision on the trend analysis as required under § 257.71(d)(2)(ix)(B)(3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the final decision in the operating record as required by the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision that the alternative source demonstration has been withdrawn (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The decision that the alternative source demonstration has been withdrawn as required under § 257.71(d)(2)(ix)(C).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the decision in the operating record as required by the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility evaluation report part 1 (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The facility evaluation report part 1 as required by § 257.75(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The facility evaluation report part 1 must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility evaluation report part 2 (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The facility evaluation report part 2 as required by § 257.75(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The facility evaluation report part 2 must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: CCR fugitive dust control plan (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The CCR fugitive dust control plan, and any subsequent amendment of the plan, required by § 257.80(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each fugitive dust control plan must be maintained for five years after closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) is completed at the last CCR unit at the facility irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual CCR fugitive dust control report (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The annual CCR fugitive dust control report required by § 257.80(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each fugitive dust control report must be maintained for five years after closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) is completed at the last CCR unit at the facility irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run-on and run-off control system plans (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial and periodic run-on and run-off control system plans as required by § 257.81(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each plan must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflow design flood control system plan (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial and periodic inflow design flood control system plan as required by § 257.82(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each plan must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection and instrumentation monitoring results by a qualified person (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation recording the results of each inspection and instrumentation monitoring by a qualified person as required by § 257.83(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each document must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Periodic inspection report (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The periodic inspection report as required by § 257.83(b)(2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each inspection report must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of weekly inspection results by a qualified person (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation recording the results of the weekly inspection by a qualified person as required by § 257.84(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each inspection report must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual groundwater monitoring and corrective action report (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The annual groundwater monitoring and corrective action report as required by § 257.90(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each annual groundwater monitoring and corrective action report must be maintained for five years after the last CCR unit at the facility either completes closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or completes post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of monitoring well/piezometer design/installation/development/decommissioning (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation of the design, installation, development, and decommissioning of any monitoring wells, piezometers and other measurement, sampling, and analytical devices as required by § 257.91(e)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each document must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Groundwater monitoring system certification (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The groundwater monitoring system certification as required by § 257.91(f).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each certification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of a statistical method certification (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The selection of a statistical method certification as required by § 257.93(f)(6).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each certification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification upon establishing an assessment monitoring program (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Within 30 days of establishing an assessment monitoring program, the notification as required by § 257.94(e)(3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the notification in the operating record within 30 days of establishing assessment monitoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results of appendices III and IV constituent concentrations (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The results of appendices III and IV to this part constituent concentrations measured as required by § 257.95(d)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record constituent concentration results in the operating record as required by the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification upon returning to a detection monitoring program (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Within 30 days of returning to a detection monitoring program, the notification as required by § 257.95(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the notification in the operating record within 30 days.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification upon detecting constituents above groundwater protection standard (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Within 30 days of detecting one or more constituents in appendix IV to this part at statistically significant levels above the groundwater protection standard, the notifications as required by § 257.95(g).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the notifications in the operating record within 30 days of detection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification upon initiating assessment of corrective measures (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Within 30 days of initiating the assessment of corrective measures requirements, the notification as required by § 257.95(g)(5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the notification in the operating record within 30 days of initiating the assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completed assessment of corrective measures (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The completed assessment of corrective measures as required by § 257.96(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each certification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of public meeting for corrective measures assessment (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation prepared by the owner or operator recording the public meeting for the corrective measures assessment as required by § 257.96(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each certification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Semiannual report and selection of remedy report (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The semiannual report describing the progress in selecting and designing the remedy and the selection of remedy report as required by § 257.97(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The selection of remedy report must be maintained until the remedy has been completed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification upon completing the remedy (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Within 30 days of completing the remedy, the notification as required by § 257.98(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each notification must be maintained for five years after completion of the remedy selected pursuant to § 257.97 irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstration supporting suspension of groundwater monitoring (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The demonstration, including long-term performance data, supporting the suspension of groundwater monitoring requirements as required by § 257.90(g).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each document must be maintained for five years after the last unit at the facility completes post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of intent to initiate closure (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of intent to initiate closure of the CCR unit as required by § 257.100(c)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the notification in the operating record as required by the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual progress reports of closure implementation (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The annual progress reports of closure implementation as required by § 257.100(c)(2)(i) and (ii).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the reports in the operating record as required by the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of closure completion (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of closure completion as required by § 257.100(c)(3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the notification in the operating record as required by the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written closure plan and amendments (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The written closure plan, and any amendment of the plan, as required by § 257.102(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the most recent closure plan must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrations for time extension to initiate closure (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The written demonstration(s), including the certification required by § 257.102(e)(2)(iii), for a time extension for initiating closure as required by § 257.102(e)(2)(ii).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each demonstration must be maintained until notice of completion of closure is placed in the operating record in accordance with § 257.102(h) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrations for time extension to complete closure (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The written demonstration(s), including the certification required by § 257.102(f)(2)(iii), for a time extension for completing closure as required by § 257.102(f)(2)(i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each demonstration must be maintained for five years after completion of closure in accordance with § 257.102(c) or (d) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of intent to close a CCR unit (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of intent to close a CCR unit as required by § 257.102(g).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each notification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure in accordance with § 257.102(c) or (d) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of completion of closure of a CCR unit (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of completion of closure of a CCR unit as required by § 257.102(h).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each notification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification recording a notation on the deed (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification recording a notation on the deed as required by § 257.102(i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each notification must be maintained for five years after completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of intent to comply with alternative closure requirements (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of intent to comply with the alternative closure requirements as required by § 257.103(c)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each notification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure in accordance with § 257.102(c) or (d) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual progress reports under alternative closure requirements (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The annual progress reports under the alternative closure requirements as required by § 257.103(c)(2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each report must be maintained for five years after completion of closure in accordance with § 257.102(c) or (d) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written post-closure plan and amendments (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The written post-closure plan, and any amendment of the plan, as required by § 257.104(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the most recent post-closure plan must be maintained for five years after completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of completion of post-closure care period (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of completion of post-closure care period as required by § 257.104(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each notification must be maintained for five years after completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notifications and approvals/denials for site-specific alternatives (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notifications, approvals, denials, requests for additional time, and semi-annual progress reports related to site-specific alternatives to initiation of closure due to infeasible development of alternative capacity or permanent cessation of coal-fired boilers (various § 257.103(f) provisions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each such notification, approval, denial, request, or report must generally be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c)(1) or (2) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements, unless a different retention is specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability report and certification for legacy CCR surface impoundments (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicability report required by § 257.100(f)(1), including the certification required by § 257.100(f)(1)(i), for legacy CCR surface impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each report must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability extension reports for legacy CCR surface impoundments (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicability extension reports required by § 257.100(f)(1)(iii)(C).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each report must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of field investigation conclusion (legacy operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of field investigation conclusion required by § 257.100(f)(1)(iii)(F) for legacy CCR surface impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of intent to certify closure for legacy CCR surface impoundments (operating record)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification of intent to certify closure required by § 257.100(h)(1)(i) for legacy CCR surface impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notification must be maintained for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.100(h)(1) or § 257.102(c)(2) irrespective of paragraph (b) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification deadline definition and extension (notifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notifications required under paragraphs (e) through (i) of § 257.106 must be sent to the relevant State Director and/or appropriate Tribal authority before the close of business on the day the notification is required to be completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 'Before the close of business' means the notification must be postmarked or sent by electronic mail (email). If a notification deadline falls on a weekend or federal holiday, the notification deadline is automatically extended to the next business day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notifications to Tribal authority (notifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: If any CCR unit is located in its entirety within Indian Country, the notifications of this section must be sent to the appropriate Tribal authority; if any CCR unit is located in part within Indian Country, notifications must be sent to both the appropriate State Director and Tribal authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the geographic rules for routing notifications to Tribal and/or State authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combining notifications (notifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notifications may be combined as long as the deadline requirement for each notification is met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combined transmissions are permitted provided each notification's deadline is satisfied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification deadline after placement in operating record (notifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless otherwise required, notifications specified in this section must be sent to the State Director and/or appropriate Tribal authority within 30 days of placing in the operating record the information required by § 257.105.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send notifications within 30 days of placing the information in the operating record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of availability of facility evaluation reports (notifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide notification of the availability of the facility evaluation report part 1 and part 2 as specified by § 257.105(f)(25) and § 257.105(f)(26).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include notifications (f)(24) and (25) in the notification requirements; send according to notification timing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notifications for legacy CCR surface impoundments (notifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: The owner or operator of a legacy CCR surface impoundment must notify the State Director and/or appropriate Tribal authority when information has been placed in the operating record and on the owner or operator's publicly accessible internet site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically provide notification of availability of applicability documentation, applicability extension report, notification under § 257.105(k)(3), and intent to certify closure by removal certification as specified under § 257.105(k)(1)-(4).

rubrics_metrics.name: CCR website title and availability requirements (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each owner/operator must maintain a publicly accessible internet site (CCR website) titled 'CCR Rule Compliance Data and Information' containing required information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All information required to be posted must be immediately available to anyone visiting the site without any prerequisite (e.g., registration). Required information must be clearly identifiable and immediately printable and downloadable. If the URL changes, notify EPA via 'contact us' form on EPA's CCR website and the State Director within 14 days. The facility website must include a 'contact us' form or specific email address for public questions/issues about availability of information.

rubrics_metrics.name: CCR website for multiple units or combined regulatory postings
rubrics_metrics.description: An owner/operator of more than one CCR unit may use the same internet site for multiple CCR units; owner/operators may combine postings required under this subpart with postings required by other regulatory programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CCR website must clearly delineate information by the name or identification number of each unit. Combined postings for other regulatory programs must be delineated under a separate heading on the website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document retention on CCR website
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless otherwise required, information required to be posted to the CCR website must be made available to the public for at least five years following the date on which the information was first posted to the CCR website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default website retention is at least five years from first posting date, except where the rule specifies different retention (e.g., certain items maintained irrespective of the five-year rule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Website posting deadline after placement in operating record
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless otherwise required, information must be posted to the CCR website within 30 days of placing the pertinent information required by § 257.105 in the operating record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Postings to the website must occur within 30 days of placing the information in the operating record unless another deadline applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location restrictions demonstration posting (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each demonstration specified under § 257.105(e) must be posted on the CCR website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each location restrictions demonstration must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) irrespective of the time requirement specified in the general website retention paragraph (c).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design certifications and construction certifications (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Design certification specified under § 257.105(f)(1) or (3) and construction certification(s) for new units must be posted on the CCR website within specified timeframes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Within 60 days of commencing construction of a new unit, post the design certification; each certification must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal or until completion of post-closure care (or until the liner is removed for construction certifications), irrespective of paragraph (c). Construction certification must be posted no later than the date of initial receipt of CCR by a new unit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of liner type (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation of liner type as specified under § 257.105(f)(2) must be posted to the CCR website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each document must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g), or until the liner is removed, whichever is later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hazard potential classification assessments (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial and periodic hazard potential classification assessments specified under § 257.105(f)(5) must be posted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the two most recent hazard potential classification assessments must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emergency action plan (EAP) (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The emergency action plan (EAP) specified under § 257.105(f)(6) must be posted on the CCR website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the most recent EAP must be maintained on the CCR website irrespective of the general website retention requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of annual face-to-face meeting/exercise with local emergency responders (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation prepared by the owner/operator recording the annual face-to-face meeting or exercise between owner/operator representatives and local emergency responders as specified under § 257.105(f)(7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the most recent documentation must be posted on the CCR website irrespective of the general website retention requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of any activation of EAP (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation recording any activation of the emergency action plan specified under § 257.105(f)(8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documentation of EAP activations must be posted; if there has been no activation in the last five years, post documentation that includes that information irrespective of the paragraph (c) time requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: History of construction (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The history of construction, and any revisions of it, specified under § 257.105(f)(9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The histories of construction and revisions must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structural stability assessments (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial and periodic structural stability assessments specified under § 257.105(f)(10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the two most recent structural stability assessments must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation detailing corrective measures (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation detailing the corrective measures taken to remedy the deficiency or release specified under § 257.105(f)(11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each document must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safety factor assessments (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial and periodic safety factor assessments specified under § 257.105(f)(12).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the two most recent safety factor assessments must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design and construction plans (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The design and construction plans, and any revisions of them, specified under § 257.105(f)(13).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each plan must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application and supplemental materials (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The application and any supplemental materials submitted in support of the application specified under § 257.105(f)(14).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each application must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative liner, extension requests, preliminary demonstration, and related decisions (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternative liner demonstration, extension requests, documentation prepared for preliminary demonstration, notifications of incomplete application, decisions on applications, and final decisions on alternative liner demonstration as specified under § 257.105(f)(15)-(20).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post the listed items; many items (e.g., decisions) must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal or until completion of post-closure care as specified elsewhere. Specific retention varies by item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative source demonstrations, trend analysis decisions, withdrawals (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternative source demonstration, final decisions on alternative source demonstration, final decision on trend analysis, and decisions that an alternative source demonstration has been withdrawn (§ 257.105(f)(21)-(24)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post the listed items; retention and duration rules described elsewhere in § 257.105(f) apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility evaluation reports parts 1 and 2 (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The facility evaluation report part 1 and part 2 as specified under § 257.105(f)(25) and (26).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each report must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: CCR fugitive dust control plan and reports (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The CCR fugitive dust control plan (and amendments) and the annual CCR fugitive dust control report specified under § 257.105(g)(1)-(2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the most recent plan must be maintained on the CCR website irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements until the last CCR unit at the facility completes closure by removal or completes post-closure care. Annual reports must be posted for the duration specified in paragraph (c) (generally five years), except the final report must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal or until completion of post-closure care irrespective of paragraph (c).

rubrics_metrics.name: Run-on/run-off and inflow design flood control plans (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial and periodic run-on and run-off control system plans and inflow design flood control system plans specified under § 257.105(g)(3)-(4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each plan must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Periodic inspection reports and corrective measures documentation (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Periodic inspection reports and documentation detailing corrective measures as specified under § 257.105(g)(6)-(7) and (g)(9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each report must be posted for the duration specified in paragraph (c), except that final reports/documentation must be posted for five years after completion of closure by removal in accordance with § 257.102(c) or until completion of post-closure care in accordance with § 257.104(e) or (g) irrespective of paragraph (c) time requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Groundwater monitoring and corrective action postings (website)
rubrics_metrics.description: The owner/operator must place the annual groundwater monitoring and corrective action report and other groundwater monitoring information on the CCR website as specified under § 257.105(h).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule begins listing specific groundwater items to be posted (e.g., annual report under § 257.105(h)(1)); posting timings and retention follow the general website rules and the specific provisions in § 257.105(h).
